audit_status.source_base: Hebrew source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Draft restoration of 2 Chronicles 34 based on supplied Hebrew: YHWH rendered as YHWH; preserves cultic reform, discovery of the law-book, Huldah’s oracle, and covenant renewal. Several textual variants flagged for witness review.

verses.restored: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign; he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.

familiar.text: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

modern.text: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.

original.text: בֶּן שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִ֖ים יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְאַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: He did what was right before YHWH, walking in the ways of David his father; he did not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

familiar.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.

modern.text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left. Josiah Destroys Idolatry (1 Kings 13:1–10; 2 Kings 23:4–20)

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדַרְכֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔יו וְלֹא סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול

verses.restored: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, the Asherah poles, the carved images and the molten images.

familiar.text: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

modern.text: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, Josiah began to seek the God of his father David, and in the twelfth year he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images.

original.text: וּבִשְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה שָׁנִ֜ים לְמָלְכ֗וֹ וְהוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ נַ֔עַר הֵחֵ֕ל לִדְר֕וֹשׁ לֵאלֹהֵ֖י דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יו וּבִשְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֗ה הֵחֵל֙ לְטַהֵ֔ר אֶת יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִן הַבָּמוֹת֙ וְהָ֣אֲשֵׁרִ֔ים וְהַפְּסִלִ֖ים וְהַמַּסֵּכֽוֹת

verses.restored: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; the images that stood above them he cut down; the groves, the carved images and the molten images he shattered, pulverized, and scattered upon the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

familiar.text: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

modern.text: Then in his presence the altars of the Baals were torn down, and he cut to pieces the incense altars that were above them. He shattered the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images, crushed them to dust, and scattered them over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

original.text: וַיְנַתְּצ֣וּ לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֚ת מִזְבְּח֣וֹת הַבְּעָלִ֔ים וְהַֽחַמָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר לְמַ֥עְלָה מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם גִּדֵּ֑עַ וְ֠הָאֲשֵׁרִים וְהַפְּסִלִ֤ים וְהַמַּסֵּכוֹת֙ שִׁבַּ֣ר וְהֵדַ֔ק וַיִּזְרֹק֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַקְּבָרִ֔ים הַזֹּבְחִ֖ים לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

familiar.text: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

notes.title: variant
notes.body: Masoretic line shows a parenthetical variant for 'their altars' (מִזְבְּחֻתָם); reading preserved here but flagged for witness check.

modern.text: Then he burned the bones of the priests on their altars. So he cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

original.text: וְעַצְמוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שָׂרַ֖ף עַל מזבחותים וַיְטַהֵ֥ר אֶת יְהוּדָ֖ה וְאֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: So he acted in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, with their mattocks all around.

familiar.text: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.

modern.text: Josiah did the same in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around them.

original.text: וּבְעָרֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה וְאֶפְרַ֛יִם וְשִׁמְע֖וֹן וְעַד נַפְתָּלִ֑י בהר בתיהם סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: When he had broken down the altars and the groves and had ground the carved images to powder, and cut down all the idols throughout the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

familiar.text: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

modern.text: He tore down the altars and Asherah poles, crushed the idols to powder, and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel. Then he returned to Jerusalem. Josiah Repairs the Temple (2 Kings 22:3–7)

original.text: וַיְנַתֵּ֣ץ אֶת הַֽמִּזְבְּח֗וֹת וְאֶת הָאֲשֵׁרִ֤ים וְהַפְּסִלִים֙ כִּתַּ֣ת לְהֵדַ֔ק וְכָל הַֽחַמָּנִ֥ים גִּדַּ֖ע בְּכָל אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֖שָׁב לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: In the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purified the land and the house, he sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the city governor, and Joah son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of YHWH his God.

familiar.text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

modern.text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, in order to cleanse the land and the temple, Josiah sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

original.text: וּבִשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ לְמָלְכ֔וֹ לְטַהֵ֥ר הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהַבָּ֑יִת שָׁ֠לַח אֶת שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן אֲצַלְיָ֜הוּ וְאֶת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֣הוּ שַׂר הָעִ֗יר וְ֠אֵת יוֹאָ֤ח בֶּן יֽוֹאָחָז֙ הַמַּזְכִּ֔יר לְחַזֵּ֕ק אֶת בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו

verses.restored: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money brought into the house of God, which the Levites, keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim and from all the remnant of Israel and from all Judah and Benjamin; then they returned to Jerusalem.

familiar.text: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

modern.text: So they went to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that had been brought into the house of God, which the Levites at the doors had collected from the people of Manasseh and Ephraim, from all the remnant of Israel, Judah, and Benjamin, and from the people of Jerusalem.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֗וֹל וַֽיִּתְּנוּ֮ אֶת הַכֶּסֶף֮ הַמּוּבָ֣א בֵית אֱלֹהִים֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָסְפֽוּ הַלְוִיִּם֩ שֹׁמְרֵ֨י הַסַּ֜ף מִיַּ֧ד מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְאֶפְרַ֗יִם וּמִכֹּל֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִכָּל יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וישבי יְרֽוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: They put it in the hand of the overseers and of the craftsmen charged with the house of YHWH, and the craftsmen gave it to those who worked in the house to repair and strengthen the house.

familiar.text: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and amend the house:

modern.text: They put it into the hands of the supervisors of those doing the work of the house of the LORD, who in turn gave it to the workmen restoring and repairing the house of the LORD.

original.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ עַל יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ עוֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לִבְדּ֥וֹק וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק הַבָּֽיִת

verses.restored: They gave it to carpenters and builders to buy hewn stone and timber for the joining and for the beams, and to rebuild the houses that the kings of Judah had ruined.

familiar.text: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

modern.text: They also gave money to the carpenters and builders to buy dressed stone, as well as timbers for couplings and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to deteriorate.

original.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ לֶחָֽרָשִׁים֙ וְלַבֹּנִ֔ים לִקְנוֹת֙ אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב וְעֵצִ֖ים לַֽמְחַבְּר֑וֹת וּלְקָרוֹת֙ אֶת הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁחִ֖יתוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: The men did the work faithfully; and the overseers over them were Jahath and Obadiah of the Levites, sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam of the sons of Kohath, to promote the work; and the Levites, all skilful in musical instruments.

familiar.text: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

modern.text: And the men did the work faithfully. The Levites overseeing them were Jahath and Obadiah, descendants of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, descendants of Kohath. Other Levites, all skilled with musical instruments,

original.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֜ה בַּמְּלָאכָ֗ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מֻ֠פְקָדִים יַ֣חַת וְעֹבַדְיָ֤הוּ הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִן בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י וּזְכַרְיָ֧ה וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם מִן בְּנֵ֥י הַקְּהָתִ֖ים לְנַצֵּ֑חַ וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם כָּל מֵבִ֖ין בִּכְלֵי שִֽׁיר

verses.restored: And over the bearers of burdens and the overseers of every kind of work were the Levites; among the Levites were scribes, officers and gatekeepers.

familiar.text: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.

modern.text: were over the laborers and supervised all who did the work, task by task. Some of the Levites were secretaries, officers, and gatekeepers. Hilkiah Finds the Book of the Law (2 Kings 22:8–13)

original.text: וְעַ֣ל הַסַּבָּלִ֗ים וּֽמְנַצְּחִים֙ לְכֹל֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה מְלָאכָ֔ה לַעֲבוֹדָ֖ה וַעֲבוֹדָ֑ה וּמֵֽהַלְוִיִּ֔ם סוֹפְרִ֥ים וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וְשׁוֹעֲרִֽים

verses.restored: When they brought out the money that had been brought into the house of YHWH, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of YHWH given by Moses.

familiar.text: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD given by Moses.

notes.title: provenance
notes.body: The description 'book of the law of YHWH given by Moses' signals canonical authority; the exact manuscript tradition and wording require witness collation.

modern.text: While they were bringing out the money that had been taken into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD written by Moses.

original.text: וּבְהוֹצִיאָ֣ם אֶת הַכֶּ֔סֶף הַמּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מָצָא֙ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת סֵ֥פֶר תּֽוֹרַת יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, 'I have found the book of the law in the house of YHWH.' And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.

familiar.text: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

modern.text: And Hilkiah said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!” And he gave it to Shaphan.

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַן חִלְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן חִלְקִיָּ֛הוּ אֶת הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֶל שָׁפָֽן

verses.restored: Shaphan carried the book to the king and reported, 'All that has been committed to your servants they are doing.'

familiar.text: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.

modern.text: Then Shaphan brought the book to the king and reported, “Your servants are doing all that has been placed in their hands.

original.text: וַיָּבֵ֨א שָׁפָ֤ן אֶת הַסֵּ֨פֶר֙ אֶל הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֨שֶׁב ע֧וֹד אֶת הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ דָּבָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר נִתַּ֥ן בְּיַד עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים

verses.restored: They have gathered together the money that was found in the house of YHWH and have delivered it into the hands of the overseers and the craftsmen.

familiar.text: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

modern.text: They have paid out the money that was found in the house of the LORD and have put it into the hands of the supervisors and workers.”

original.text: וַיַּתִּ֕יכוּ אֶת הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַנִּמְצָ֣א בְּבֵית יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּהוּ עַל יַד֙ הַמֻּפְקָדִ֔ים וְעַל יַ֖ד עוֹשֵׂ֥י הַמְּלָאכָֽה

verses.restored: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, 'Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.' And Shaphan read it before the king.

familiar.text: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

modern.text: Moreover, Shaphan the scribe told the king, “Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.” And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king.

original.text: וַיַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַסּוֹפֵר֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔י חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיִּקְרָא ב֥וֹ שָׁפָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: When the king heard the words of the law he tore his clothes.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.

modern.text: When the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his clothes

original.text: וַיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת בְּגָדָֽיו

verses.restored: The king commanded Hilkiah and Ahikam son of Shaphan and Abdon son of Micah and Shaphan the scribe and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying:

familiar.text: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

modern.text: and commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the servant of the king:

original.text: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת חִלְקִיָּ֡הוּ וְאֶת אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁ֠פָן וְאֶת עַבְדּ֨וֹן בֶּן מִיכָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֗ר וְאֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Go, inquire of YHWH for me and for those left in Israel and Judah, concerning the words of the book that has been found; for great is the wrath of YHWH which is poured out upon us because our fathers did not keep the word of YHWH to do according to all that is written in this book.

familiar.text: Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.

modern.text: “Go and inquire of the LORD for me and for those remaining in Israel and Judah concerning the words in the book that has been found. For great is the wrath of the LORD that has been poured out on us because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD by doing all that is written in this book.” Huldah’s Prophecy (2 Kings 22:14–20)

original.text: לְכוּ֩ דִרְשׁ֨וּ אֶת יְהוָ֜ה בַּעֲדִ֗י וּבְעַד֙ הַנִּשְׁאָר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּבִֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַל דִּבְרֵ֥י הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א כִּֽי גְדוֹלָ֤ה חֲמַת יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִתְּכָ֣ה בָ֔נוּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא שָׁמְר֤וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֨ינוּ֙ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּכָל הַכָּת֖וּב עַל הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Hilkiah and the men whom the king had appointed went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum son of Tikvath son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; and she dwelt in Jerusalem in the second quarter; and they spoke to her.

familiar.text: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.

notes.title: location-term
notes.body: The phrase 'in the second quarter' (מִשְׁנֶה) describes Huldah’s dwelling; exact institutional meaning merits witness-check.

modern.text: So Hilkiah and those the king had designated went and spoke to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, the keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the Second District.

original.text: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ חִלְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶל חֻלְדָּ֨ה הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֵ֣שֶׁת שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן תוקהת בֶּן חַסְרָה֙ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְהִ֛יא יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יהָ כָּזֹֽאת

verses.restored: She answered them, 'Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Tell the man who sent you to me—'

familiar.text: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,

modern.text: And Huldah said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Tell the man who sent you

original.text: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם כֹּה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִמְר֣וּ לָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי

verses.restored: Thus says YHWH: Behold, I will bring calamity upon this place and upon its inhabitants, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah.

familiar.text: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:

modern.text: that this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people, according to all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah,

original.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה עַל הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְעַל יוֹשְׁבָ֑יו אֵ֤ת כָּל הָאָלוֹת֙ הַכְּתוּב֣וֹת עַל הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָֽרְא֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods to provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place and shall not be quenched.

familiar.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

modern.text: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. My wrath will be poured out upon this place and will not be quenched.’

original.text: תַּ֣חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי ויקטירו לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֨עַן֙ הַכְעִיסֵ֔נִי בְּכֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וְתִתַּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֛י בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה

verses.restored: And to the king of Judah who sent you to inquire of YHWH you shall say, 'Thus says YHWH God of Israel concerning the words which you have heard.'

familiar.text: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;

modern.text: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘As for the words that you heard,

original.text: וְאֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַשֹּׁלֵ֤חַ אֶתְכֶם֙ לִדְר֣וֹשׁ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑יו כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתָּ

verses.restored: Because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and its inhabitants, and you humbled yourself and tore your clothes and wept before me, I have heard you, declares YHWH.

familiar.text: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the LORD.

modern.text: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God when you heard His words against this place and against its people, and because you have humbled yourself before Me and you have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have heard you,’ declares the LORD.

original.text: יַ֠עַן רַךְ לְבָ֨בְךָ֜ וַתִּכָּנַ֣ע מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֗ים בְּשָׁמְעֲךָ֤ אֶת דְּבָרָיו֙ עַל הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וְעַל יֹ֣שְׁבָ֔יו וַתִּכָּנַ֣ע לְפָנַ֔י וַתִּקְרַ֥ע אֶת בְּגָדֶ֖יךָ וַתֵּ֣בְךְּ לְפָנָ֑י וְגַם אֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace; your eyes shall not see all the evil that I will bring upon this place and upon its inhabitants.' So they brought the king word back again.

familiar.text: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

modern.text: ‘Now I will indeed gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.’” So they brought her answer back to the king. Josiah Renews the Covenant (2 Kings 23:1–3)

original.text: הִנְנִ֨י אֹֽסִפְךָ֜ אֶל אֲבֹתֶ֗יךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ֣ אֶל קִבְרֹתֶיךָ֮ בְּשָׁלוֹם֒ וְלֹא תִרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹל֙ הָֽרָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא עַל הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְעַל יֹשְׁבָ֑יו וַיָּשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָֽר

verses.restored: Then the king sent and gathered all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

familiar.text: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

modern.text: Then the king summoned all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֶּאֱסֹ֕ף אֶת כָּל זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: The king went up to the house of YHWH, with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests and the Levites and all the people, great and small; and he read to them in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of YHWH.

familiar.text: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.

modern.text: And he went up to the house of the LORD with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, as well as the priests and the Levites—all the people small and great—and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD.

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַל הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית יְ֠הוָה וְכָל אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְכָל הָעָ֖ם מִגָּד֣וֹל וְעַד קָטָ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֣א בְאָזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית הַנִּמְצָ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before YHWH, to walk after YHWH and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant written in this book.

familiar.text: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

modern.text: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to follow the LORD and to keep His commandments, decrees, and statutes with all his heart and all his soul, and to carry out the words of this covenant that were written in this book.

original.text: וַיַּעֲמֹ֨ד הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ עַל עָמְד֗וֹ וַיִּכְרֹ֣ת אֶֽת הַבְּרִית֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ לָלֶ֜כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וְלִשְׁמ֤וֹר אֶת מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וְעֵֽדְוֺתָ֣יו וְחֻקָּ֔יו בְּכָל לְבָב֖וֹ וּבְכָל נַפְשׁ֑וֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַבְּרִ֔ית הַכְּתוּבִ֖ים עַל הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: He made all that were present in Jerusalem and in Benjamin stand to the covenant; and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of the God of their fathers.

familiar.text: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

modern.text: Then he had everyone in Jerusalem and Benjamin take a stand in agreement to it. So all the people of Jerusalem carried out the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

original.text: וַיַּעֲמֵ֕ד אֵ֛ת כָּל הַנִּמְצָ֥א בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּבְרִ֥ית אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Josiah removed all the abominations from all the lands that belonged to the children of Israel, and he made all who remained in Israel serve YHWH their God; all his days they did not turn aside from following YHWH, the God of their fathers.

familiar.text: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. And all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

modern.text: And Josiah removed all the abominations from all the lands belonging to the Israelites, and he required everyone in Israel to serve the LORD their God. Throughout his reign they did not turn aside from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

original.text: וַיָּ֨סַר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֜הוּ אֶת כָּל הַתּוֹעֵב֗וֹת מִֽכָּל הָאֲרָצוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַֽיַּעֲבֵ֗ד אֵ֤ת כָּל הַנִּמְצָא֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲב֖וֹד אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כָּל יָמָ֕יו לֹ֣א סָ֔רוּ מֵֽאַחֲרֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם

translation_notes: Divine name rendered YHWH throughout. The Hebrew book found is rendered literally as 'book of the law (sefer torah)' with provenance left open. Preserve cultic and judicial language without theological harmonization.
Where the Masoretic text shows bracketed/parenthetical variants those readings are preserved or signalled in notes. Hebrew technical terms are given at verse level (max two).
safety_note: Contains descriptions of cult destruction, prophetic denunciation, divine wrath and collective punishment; treat responsibly and avoid violent endorsement.
source_witness_audit_flags: verse5: bracketed reading around 'altars' — verify Masoretic/parashah variants
verse14–19: provenance and wording of 'book of the law' (sefer torah) — establish manuscript witness
verses22–28: Huldah oracle wording, her titulary and location (מִשְׁנֶה) — verify variant readings and dating
